Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the docs. A couple quick items so we can move this through our Procure/Finance workflow: 

1) We require a completed vendor change request form signed by an authorized PayFlow signatory. Im attaching the form to this reply — could Marco or you sign and return? (If you prefer DocuSign I can send the envelope.)
2) For security we validate the last 4 digits of the prior account on file. Can you confirm the last 4 digits of the previous account so I can mark the verification step complete?
3) Well need a clear statement on whether this change applies to all existing POs/invoices or only new invoices moving forward. If you want existing open invoices re-routed, please call that out explicitly.

Ccd Karthik from AP to prep for the remittance switch — Karthik, once we have the signed change request and the confirmation of prior account digits well kick the internal ticket to change bank routing. Please advise on expected lead time to propagate the change across our PO routing rules.

Thanks — Ill hold until Marco signs the form or confirms DocuSign.
